english: On hearing the words of Nārada, he looked at the Kañcukin, the elderly stāff-bearing officer of the womens’ inner apartment, endowed with good qualities. Delighted in his heart, the king made the quarters reverberate with his voice and told him: “O Kañcukin, may the chief queen accompanied by all the attendants of the inner apartment unhesitatingly grant an audience to Nārada.” In view of the command of his master, he grasped the hand of Nārada, entered the apartment and said to the queen: “This is Nāraḍa who has come to see you.” On seeing the excellent sage, she bowed down to his feet and offered an excellent golden seat, Arghyapādya and other things. The holy sage who was pleased offered her the greatest blessing and said: “O queen, in the entire range of the three worlds, no other woman like you is seen, who is chaste, well-behaved and endowed with truthfulness and cleanliness. It is by your power that the set of the three cities always whirls like a wheel.”
